_about: cfn-careful rm guard zones (skills/cfn-careful/lib/rm-target-check.py). Entries are glob patterns, ~ allowed. allow_zones: anything strictly inside a match is deleted without a prompt (temp, scratch, build output); /tmp and $TMPDIR are built in. trash_zones: anything at or under a match goes to the trash (cfn-trash.sh) instead of being deleted. protected: never deleted, nor anything under it, nor a folder holding it. deny_exact: that folder itself (and its parents) is never deleted; things inside it keep the normal rules. Tests point CFN_CAREFUL_ZONES_FILE at their own copy.
